rationale: The Latin anchors *sculpere* (to carve/engrave) and *delineare* (to sketch/outline), combined with the attestation referencing an image of the Lord depicted on a tablet (*imaginem Domini Salvatoris in tabula depictam*), firmly point to a pictorial/representational sense. Among the candidates, draw.v.06 ("represent by making a drawing of") best captures the act of rendering a visual image on a surface, which aligns with both the Latin and the OE context of inscribing or depicting figures.
